'''Alto Janss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who often visited [[Tolea Biqua]], in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over [[Genarius]], during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was frequently found in the [[Near Vacuum Cantina]] in the company of her two lieutenants, who also acted as her bodyguards. Janss' customized [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was named the ''[[Long Spoon]]''.
